facts.fact: Biometric Update reports Law 2024/016, the new civil-registration law, as the law BUNEC is implementing; it is an ordinary law, and the document gives no promulgation date, so the publication date is used.

Biometric Update says Law 2024/016 authorises digital birth, marriage and death certificates and a Unique Personal Identification Number for every citizen; the document gives no date for this other than its own publication.
